claim: DNS query resolution from the Route 53 data plane continues to work normally during Regional service impairment. Accelerated recovery is about regaining the ability to make DNS changes: during a failover, Route 53 routes control plane requests for enabled hosted zones to the US West (Oregon) Region.

evidence.quote: DNS query resolution from the Route 53 data plane continues to work normally during Regional service impairment.
It then routes control plane requests for your enabled hosted zones to the US West (Oregon) Region.

Accelerated recovery targets a 60-minute recovery time objective (RTO) for regaining the ability to make DNS changes to your DNS records in Route 53 public hosted zones, if AWS services in US East (N. Virginia) become temporarily unavailable.
